title: Bristol Myers Squibb Merges Research and Development Teams Under CMO Cristian Massacesi
summary: Bengaluru: Bristol Myers Squibb said on Thursday it will combine its scientific and clinical expertise teams into an end-to-end research and development department under current Chief Medical Officer...
thbAction: Position THB's pharma CRM and omnichannel HCP engagement workflows to support launch planning, KAM orchestration, and compliant follow-up across India and the Middle East.
contentHtml:
Bengaluru: Bristol Myers Squibb said on Thursday it will combine its scientific and clinical expertise teams into an end-to-end research and development department under current Chief Medical Officer Cristian Massacesi, effective January 1, 2027.

Current Chief Research Officer Robert Plenge will leave in March 2027 after the transition.

"Bringing Research and Development together as one organization is an important step in our work to position BMS for long-term growth," said CEO Christopher Boerner.

Analysts are closely watching Bristol's drug development pipeline for clues on growth.

"Under Cristian's leadership, this new structure will more closely connect our scientific and clinical expertise across R&D, accelerate decision making and ultimately enhance portfolio execution," Boerner said.

Source : Reuters
